note: Prompts for the photoreal room stills (gen_rooms.py). Same camera and furniture in every room; the time of day, weather, lamp and label colour change per station. labelSeed is a pixel on the record label for calibrate.mjs; stamp is the camcorder date and the time the tape starts (it runs on the broadcast clock and loops each hour).
base: Photograph of a real lived-in mid-1990s American wood-paneled den, {light}. Shot straight on at eye level from across the room, the camera square to the back wall. In the center of the frame stands a large 27-inch 1990s CRT television with a dark grey plastic cabinet and a curved glass screen, on a low wooden TV stand with a VCR on the shelf below. The television screen is filled edge to edge with flat, solid, pure chroma-key green (#00FF00), evenly lit, no reflections, no picture. In the lower right foreground, on a wooden record cabinet, a belt-drive turntable seen from slightly above, with a black vinyl record on the platter and a {label} paper center label; the tonearm rests on the outer edge of the record, the dust cover is off. On the left, a glowing {lamp} lava lamp on a side table next to a stack of cassette tapes. {window} A framed abstract print on the paneling, a houseplant, beige carpet. {extra} Natural, photorealistic, real objects, correct perspective, 35mm lens. No people, no text, no logos, no brand names.
